content: Demand not that events should happen as you wish; but wish them to happen as they do happen, and you will go on well.
author: Epictetus
story:
Born into slavery in Hierapolis and physically crippled by a brutal master in imperial Rome, Epictetus acquired his freedom after Nero's death and founded a renowned philosophical academy in Nicopolis. Having experienced genuine subjugation, he founded his philosophy on the inviolable inner freedom of the human will: chains may bind the body, but no tyrant can conquer the faculty of choice.

In formulating this reflection, Epictetus stripped away superficial conventions to address the core anatomy of acceptance. For Epictetus, true wisdom is never an abstract luxury, but an urgent practical discipline required to navigate life with clarity and unshakeable dignity.
reflectionPrompt: How can you integrate the essence of this wisdom into one specific decision or encounter today?
